$comment: Voiceover, one line per scene. `say` is what the voice engine reads (AI;DR is written 'AI DR' so it is read as four quick letters); `text` is the caption form. Hosts alternate, opener and closer differ (videos/brand/voices.json). Every claim is sourced in data/claims.md.

lines.text: AI news never stops. The same story shows up everywhere, under new headlines.
AI;DR is a machine that reads it for you.
lines.say: AI DR is a machine that reads it for you.

lines.text: Every 30 minutes, it pulls from Hacker News, Hugging Face, GitHub releases, Lobsters and RSS feeds.
lines.say: Every thirty minutes, it pulls from Hacker News, Hugging Face, GitHub releases, Lobsters, and RSS feeds.

lines.text: It merges duplicates into one story. Then it scores each one.
No editor picks the order. The ranking is plain code, and the rules are public.
The top stories of the last 24 hours become one edition. Up to 16 bullets, in English and in Vietnamese.
lines.say: The top stories of the last twenty-four hours become one edition. Up to sixteen bullets, in English, and in Vietnamese.

lines.text: Read it on the site. By email from 7 a.m., your time. On Telegram, on Facebook, and as a daily video.
lines.say: Read it on the site. By email from seven a.m., your time. On Telegram, on Facebook, and as a daily video.

lines.text: Every story links to the original. AI;DR. What's happening in AI today?
lines.say: Every story links to the original. AI DR. What's happening in AI today?
